title: TEDxTokyo — シン・ニホン：データ時代の日本の可能性 (Shin Nihon: Japan's Potential in the Data Era)
description: TEDxTokyo talk in Japanese by 安宅 和人 (Kazuto Ataka, Yahoo Japan CSO). Argues that Japan is at a turning point for the data/AI era — 'Shin Nihon' (new Japan) — and calls on the next generation to harness Japan's strengths in craft, nature, and depth of knowledge. Dense business and technology vocabulary at N2–N3 level.
